cohort: The study included 18,973,800 newborn infants admitted during the years 2016-2020.
finding: Maternal chorioamnionitis is associated with an increased incidence of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), particularly in the birth weight category of 2500-4499 g.
birth_weight: Various birthweight categories were analyzed, with specific findings highlighted for 2500-4499 g.
